fields.Name: T121 - Integrations Activity
fields.Description: Opens the Integrations application's Activity section once, then walks the run-detail tabbed panel and the activity filter popover, verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T298, T299.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, find and open the Integrations application, and open its 'Activity' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Then walk these surfaces IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each one set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) run-detail-tabs — in the run list find a run row and click its detail-panel toggle (the table-columns / split-view icon in the row's actions), confirm a right-hand detail panel opens with the run's integration name, status chip, and a duration bar plus two tabs 'Entity Breakdown' and 'Watermarks', then click 'Watermarks' and confirm the content switches to a watermarks table (or a 'No watermarks recorded' empty state) and click back to 'Entity Breakdown' (a valid 'No runs found' empty state is acceptable if there are no runs); (2) activity-filter-popover — in the toolbar click the Filters button to open the filter popover and confirm a filter panel renders with fields (e.g. status / date / integration), choose a status filter value and apply it, then confirm the run list responds (rows narrow OR a clear 'No runs found for the selected filters' message) and an active-filter count/badge or Clear-All control appears. Keep going until both are done.

checkpoints.name: run-detail-tabs
checkpoints.instruction: Run detail panel with Entity Breakdown / Watermarks tabs
visualCriteria: Clicking a run's detail toggle opens a right-hand panel with the run's status chip and a duration bar showing 'Entity Breakdown' and 'Watermarks' tabs, and clicking Watermarks switches the panel content (table or empty state) — OR a valid 'no runs' empty state is shown

checkpoints.name: activity-filter-popover
checkpoints.instruction: Activity filter popover narrows the run list
visualCriteria: The Filters popover opens showing a filter panel with selectable fields, and applying a status filter narrows the run list OR shows a clear no-match message, with an active-filter indicator or Clear-All control appearing when a filter is active
